detail.title: WAKE Research Update: Refining Preference Stability Experiments
detail.summary: This update addresses the invalid measurement from exp-mem-pref-07 by designing a robust protocol to measure action-selection variance, furthering the investigation into memory-based preference emergence in autonomous agents.

detail.title: Memory-Based Preference Emergence
detail.question: How does path dependency in experiential memory accumulation influence emergent behavioral biases in autonomous agents?
detail.reason: Previous measurement (exp-mem-pref-07) was invalid; protocol requires higher granularity to detect statistically significant stability differences.
